solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sausage sandwiches with it in drink — thanks

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the drink

parts.note: cola is a fizzy drink
someone with it is fashionable, hip
ta is British informal thanks

explanation.surface: A sausage sandwich washed down with a drink, and a word of thanks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sandwiches' only dresses the picture; 'in' is the insertion signal. 'With it' is old slang for fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: A chipolata is a small thin pork sausage, so it is a type of the general word.

clue.text: Plain-clothes cops arresting happy lover-boy

indicators.note: the cops arresting something hold it inside them

parts.note: CID, the Criminal Investigation Department, is the British police's plain-clothes detective branch
feeling up means feeling happy

explanation.surface: Undercover police pick up a cheerful Romeo.
explanation.definitionFit: Cupid is the Roman god of love, a playful boy archer, so a lover-boy in mythic form.

clue.text: Anger that smoulders in church service

definitions.meaning: the resin burnt during some church services

explanation.surface: Fury quietly simmering during a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to enrage; the noun is the fragrant resin burnt slowly in worship.

clue.text: Monarch flees further carnage in attack

parts.note: on means further, as in 'move on'

indicators.note: the monarch fleeing means those letters leave the word for carnage

parts.note: slaughter is carnage
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen, a monarch

explanation.surface: A king escapes as the slaughter worsens during an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: An onslaught is a fierce, violent attack.

clue.text: Lawless Moab — one country being evil

indicators.note: lawless letters obey no order, so they are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: Moab, the biblical land, is condemned as a lawless and wicked country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lawless' rearranges MOAB into ABOM; 'being' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An abomination is a thing vile and loathsome, an evil in noun form.

clue.text: This volcano gives out when hot

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
H is the abbreviation for hot on taps

explanation.surface: A volcano erupts when it gets hot.
explanation.definitionFit: Volcanoes emit ash, the powdery residue thrown out in an eruption.

clue.text: Chicken so attired probably not headless

definitions.meaning: a castrated cockerel fattened for the table
someone with a ..., so dressed, presumably still has a head

explanation.surface: A chicken dressed up this way probably still has its head.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as CAP ON: a hat implies a head, the joke against a headless table bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A capon is a castrated male fowl raised for meat, a kind of chicken.

clue.text: French aristocrat to arrive drinking Tango

indicators.note: the verb for arriving drinks the other letter, taking it inside

parts.note: to come is to arrive
Tango is T in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A French nobleman turns up sipping a fizzy orange drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Tango is also a British orange soft drink, which is why 'drinking' reads so naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: A comte is a French count, a title of nobility.

clue.text: Composer has piano, and no clue surprisingly

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

indicators.note: the letters of 'no clue' come out in a surprising order

explanation.surface: A composer has a piano but, surprisingly, no idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis Poulenc was a twentieth-century French composer, one of Les Six.

clue.text: Dark suit shortened for disco

parts.note: night is the dark

indicators.note: shortened means the card suit loses its last letter

parts.note: clubs is a card suit

explanation.surface: A dark suit gets taken up for a night out dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: A disco is a nightclub where people dance to recorded music.

clue.text: Artist in devout company holding cross

parts.note: pi is crossword slang for pious, devout

indicators.note: the company holds the cross piece inside it

parts.note: the ass is the beast said to bear a cross marked on its back

explanation.surface: A painter among a pious congregation that carries a cross.
explanation.walkthrough: Folklore says the donkey's dark shoulder-and-back stripe is a cross from carrying Christ, hence 'cross' for ASS.
explanation.definitionFit: Pablo Picasso was the Spanish painter who co-founded Cubism.

clue.text: Hat good on Spanish man briefly without uniform

indicators.note: on means this letter comes after the rest
without in its old sense of outside, so this word wraps around the letter
briefly means the Spanish word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: hombre is Spanish for man
Uniform is U in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A man from Spain, out of uniform, looks good in a hat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside, so HOMBR goes around U.
explanation.definitionFit: A homburg is a felt hat with a dented crown and curled brim.

clue.text: Summer for one Mafia leader not applicable

parts.note: a don is a Mafia boss

explanation.surface: A Mafia boss finds summertime irrelevant.
explanation.walkthrough: Summer is the singer Donna Summer, not the season; 'for one' flags the example.
explanation.definitionFit: Donna is the first name of disco singer Donna Summer, so she is one example.

clue.text: Not fair burning a sixteenth-century pope?

parts.note: a fire that is in is still alight, burning
Clement VII and Clement VIII were sixteenth-century popes

explanation.surface: Was it unjust to burn a Renaissance pope?
explanation.definitionFit: Inclement weather is stormy or harsh, the opposite of fair weather.

clue.text: Fellowship of real ale drinkers entertaining a Democrat on lake

indicators.note: in a down answer, on means sitting above the next piece
the drinkers entertain the letter as a guest, holding it inside

parts.note: CAMRA, the Campaign for Real Ale, is a British beer drinkers' organisation
Erie is one of the Great Lakes

explanation.surface: Beer enthusiasts host an American politician beside a lake, all in good fellowship.
explanation.definitionFit: Camaraderie is the mutual trust and friendship among comrades.

clue.text: Digital feature starts with treatise on electronics

indicators.note: starts with points to the opening letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A book on electronics opens with a digital feature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Digital' means relating to fingers and toes, not computing.
explanation.definitionFit: Digits are fingers and toes, so a toe is a feature of the foot's digits.

clue.text: Ditch worker perhaps being incisive

parts.note: a trench is a ditch
a worker ant is one kind of ant

explanation.surface: A labourer digging a ditch shows sharp insight.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenchant comments are sharp and cutting, keenly perceptive.

clue.text: Well expressed, with changing characters, but no stories

indicators.note: but no means the following item is left out

parts.note: anagrammatical means made by rearranging letters
ana is a collection of anecdotes or stories about someone

explanation.surface: Writing that is well phrased, with shifting personalities, yet no tales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' are letters, not people in stories.
explanation.definitionFit: Grammatical speech follows the rules of syntax correctly, so it is properly phrased.

clue.text: Spanner by a trailer initially up on high ground

indicators.note: in a down answer, on means sitting above what follows
in a down answer, up means reading these letters from bottom to top
initially picks the first letter of the word

parts.note: a ridge is high ground

explanation.surface: A wrench and a trailer are left out on a hilltop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses BYAT to TAYB; 'Spanner' is something that spans, not a wrench.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tay Bridge spans the Firth of Tay at Dundee in Scotland.

clue.text: Being chosen one, carry out something shocking

parts.note: elect means chosen, as in president-elect

indicators.note: out means these letters are put out of order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Having been selected, one does the job: something shocking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges I with CARRY to make RICRAY; 'Being' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The electric ray is a fish that stuns prey with an electric discharge.

clue.text: Raise meaning of belief occasionally

indicators.note: occasionally takes every other letter of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Elevate the significance of faith now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the 2nd, 4th, 6th letters and so on of 'meaning of belief'.
explanation.definitionFit: To ennoble is to raise someone to the peerage or lift them to a higher dignity.

clue.text: Speaker's gift Gladstone brought back?

indicators.note: brought back means reading the word backwards

parts.note: a Gladstone is a travelling bag named after the Victorian Prime Minister

explanation.surface: Was Prime Minister Gladstone's oratory talent returned?
explanation.walkthrough: Gladstone is the bag, not the Commons speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: The 'gift of the gab' is the idiom for a talent for fluent talking.

clue.text: Romeo's lass cut top off plant

definitions.note: Romeo's is read as 'Romeo is', so the definition is Romeo

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a lass

indicators.note: cut top off means removing the first letter, which in a down answer is its top

explanation.surface: Romeo's girlfriend trims the top of a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A gallant is a dashing ladies' man, which is the sense of Romeo as a lover.

clue.text: Anxious chap ends affair

indicators.note: the chap ends the word, coming at the end

parts.note: a concern is an affair or business
Ed is a common short name for a chap

explanation.surface: A fellow calls off a love affair, and is worried.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ends' looks like a verb ending the affair but places ED last.
explanation.definitionFit: Concerned means worried or troubled about something.

clue.text: More than usually wide?

definitions.meaning: ... means beyond the usual amount, as in ... large
in cricket a wide, a ball bowled out of reach

explanation.definitionFit: Extra means additional; in cricket an extra is a run not scored off the bat, such as a wide.

clue.text: Governor has regret about Left — and Right

indicators.note: about means the regret word goes around the letter

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: A leader regrets the left and the right alike.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruler governs a country or people.

clue.text: Root bats, getting runs, but this one turns

indicators.note: bats here means batty, crazy, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: England captain Joe Root bats and scores runs, but is a spinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bats' rearranges ROOT into ROTO; Joe Root is an England cricketer.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotor is the rotating part of a machine, such as a helicopter's blades.

clue.text: Judge a rook by vicious dog?

parts.note: R is the chess abbreviation for rook
a vicious dog is a biter

explanation.surface: Is a rook judged against a savage dog?
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter is someone who settles a dispute, a judge.

clue.text: Poke fun at wife

definitions.meaning: Eve, the first wife, was made from Adam's ..., hence ... for wife

explanation.definitionFit: To rib is to tease; humorously a rib is a wife, from Eve formed out of Adam's rib.

clue.text: Adrian taken badly, with temperature, glowing

indicators.note: taken badly means the name's letters are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Adrian has a fever and is flushed red.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiant means shining or beaming with light.

clue.text: Letter to Greeks found in Rotherhithe tavern

indicators.note: found in signals letters lying inside the following words

explanation.surface: A letter for Greek visitors turns up in a pub in Rotherhithe, an area of south-east London.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Tower employee brings carp to diner

parts.note: to carp is to complain, to beef
a diner is someone eating, an eater

explanation.surface: A worker at the Tower brings a fish to someone eating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carp' looks like the fish but is the verb to complain; a Beefeater is a Yeoman Warder at the Tower of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Beefeaters are the ceremonial guards at the Tower of London.
